title: NeutronOS signed update manifest envelope
$comment: signedPayload decodes to UTF-8 JSON containing product, codename, version, channel, architecture, artifact {url,sha256,size}, releaseNotes, releaseTimestamp, minimumCompatibleVersion, minimumUpdaterVersion, updateFormatVersion, and rollbackCompatible. The OpenPGP detached signature covers the exact decoded signedPayload bytes and must verify against the independently installed pinned NeutronOS release public key.
